class.name: OcgGeomCircle
class.brief_description: Describes a circle in 3D space. A circle is defined by its radius and, as with any conic curve, is positioned in space with a right-handed coordinate system (gp_Ax2 object) where: - the origin is the center of the circle, and - the origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" define the plane of the circle. This coordinate system is the local coordinate system of the circle. The "main Direction" of this coordinate system is the vector normal to the plane of the circle. The axis, of which the origin and unit vector are respectively the origin and "main Direction" of the local coordinate system, is termed the "Axis" or "main Axis" of the circle. The "main Direction" of the local coordinate system gives an explicit orientation to the circle (definition of the trigonometric sense), determining the direction in which the parameter increases along the circle. The Geom_Circle circle is parameterized by an angle: P(U) = O + R*Cos(U)*XDir + R*Sin(U)*YDir, where: - P is the point of parameter U, - O, XDir and YDir are respectively the origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of its local coordinate system, - R is the radius of the circle. The "X Axis" of the local coordinate system therefore defines the origin of the parameter of the circle. The parameter is the angle with this "X Direction". A circle is a closed and periodic curve. The period is 2.*Pi and the parameter range is [ 0, 2.*Pi [.

method.name: from_1
method.description: Constructs a circle by conversion of the gp_Circ circle C.

method.name: from_2
method.description: Constructs a circle of radius Radius, where A2 locates the circle and defines its orientation in 3D space such that: - the center of the circle is the origin of A2, - the origin, "X Direction" and "Y Direction" of A2 define the plane of the circle, - A2 is the local coordinate system of the circle. Note: It is possible to create a circle where Radius is equal to 0.0. raised if Radius < 0.

method.name: SetCirc
method.description: Set <me> so that <me> has the same geometric properties as C.

method.name: SetRadius
method.description: Assigns the value R to the radius of this circle. Note: it is possible to have a circle with a radius equal to 0.0. Exceptions - Standard_ConstructionError if R is negative.

method.name: Circ
method.description: returns the non transient circle from gp with the same geometric properties as <me>.

method.name: Radius
method.description: Returns the radius of this circle.

method.name: ReversedParameter
method.description: Computes the parameter on the reversed circle for the point of parameter U on this circle. For a circle, the returned value is: 2.*Pi - U.

method.name: Eccentricity
method.description: Returns the eccentricity e = 0 for a circle.

method.name: FirstParameter
method.description: Returns the value of the first parameter of this circle. This is 0.0, which gives the start point of this circle, or The start point and end point of a circle are coincident.

method.name: LastParameter
method.description: Returns the value of the last parameter of this circle. This is 2.*Pi, which gives the end point of this circle. The start point and end point of a circle are coincident.

method.name: IsClosed
method.description: returns True.

method.name: IsPeriodic
method.description: returns True.

method.name: D0
method.description: Returns in P the point of parameter U. P = C + R * Cos (U) * XDir + R * Sin (U) * YDir where C is the center of the circle , XDir the XDirection and YDir the YDirection of the circle's local coordinate system.

method.name: D1
method.description: Returns the point P of parameter U and the first derivative V1.

method.name: D2
method.description: Returns the point P of parameter U, the first and second derivatives V1 and V2.

method.name: D3
method.description: Returns the point P of parameter u, the first second and third derivatives V1 V2 and V3.

method.name: DN
method.description: The returned vector gives the value of the derivative for the order of derivation N. Raised if N < 1.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Applies the transformation T to this circle.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Creates a new object which is a copy of this circle.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream
